Net fees: critic raised a concrete objection: Your “median YoY growth” is miscomputed. With the two stated observations −14.0% (FY2023→FY2024) and −12.7% (FY2024→FY2025), the median (average of the two central values when n=2) is −13.35%, not −13.33%. Applying −13.35% to the reported FY2025 base £972.4m gives £842.4m, not £842.8m, so the proposed £842.775m is overstated by roughly £0.4m.
Pre-exceptional basic EPS: critic raised a concrete objection: You mixed periods in the growth input: the -64.9% figure is an H1 2026 year-on-year change, not a full-year FY-to-FY change, yet it was included to compute the median YoY and then applied to the full-year FY2025 EPS of 1.31p to estimate full-year FY2026. Using an H1 change alongside full-year changes (FY2023→FY2024 and FY2024→FY2025) is a wrong basis for a full-year forecast and likely biases the result.
Pre-exceptional operating profit: critic raised a concrete objection: Wrong fiscal period basis: the forecast for FY2026 (full-year) was derived from an H1 2025 figure (25.5) and H1-based growth rates, including a mixed-period “FY2024→H1 2025” growth of -75.7%. The correct comparator for FY2026 should be FY2025 full-year pre-exceptional operating profit and a full-year YoY growth rate. Using H1 2025 (25.5) as the prior-year same period and mixing FY and H1 growths invalidates the -0.2565 GBPm estimate.

Worldwide net sales and revenues: critic raised a concrete objection: Wrong basis: the +12.05% YoY uplift is taken from FY2022Q3→FY2023Q3, but Deere’s most recent same‑quarter comp shows FY2025Q3 “Worldwide net sales and revenues” DOWN 9% YoY to $12,018m. Applying a positive double‑digit YoY to project FY2026Q3 off that base ignores the current downcycle evident in the latest reported quarter for the same period, making $13,465.9m likely overstated. This is checkable against Deere’s FY2025 Q3 press release citing the −9% to $12.018 billion.
Diluted EPS (GAAP): critic raised a concrete objection: The -1.4% “post‑guidance tilt” violates your own ±6.0% cap given the listed signals (-0.70, -0.50, +0.50). Production & Precision Ag operating prof: critic raised a concrete objection: You used “FY2025Q3 (13.6)” as the prior-year operating profit in USDm, but the source shows 13.6% is an operating margin, not a dollar profit.
